claim: For the single-species PVBS Hamiltonian on the diagonal half-space \(D=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb Z^2:x+y\ge0\}\) with equal couplings \(0<\lambda<1\), the one-particle Bloch fiber at boundary quasimomentum \(k\in[-\pi,\pi]\) has a unique eigenvalue below its bulk band, \(E_{\mathrm{edge}}(k)=\frac{2\lambda^2}{1+\lambda^2}\sin^2(k/2)\), with transverse decay ratio \(r(k)=\lambda\cos(k/2)\) and exact separation \(\frac{2(1-\lambda\cos(k/2))^2}{1+\lambda^2}\) from the bulk-band lower edge.

correctness.rationale: The one-particle fiber is explicitly reduced to a half-line Jacobi operator. The decaying root and boundary condition determine the eigenvalue uniquely below the bulk band; the \(k=\pm\pi\) endpoint is handled separately. The exact positive separation and small-\(k\) expansion follow algebraically. The Bloch-wave limitation is stated explicitly.
